title: Manual Dispatch Activation — Supervisor Greene

transcript.speaker: Supervisor Greene
transcript.text: This is Supervisor Greene. I’ve opened Position 12 and moved the Position 7 police dispatcher to call taking only. All call takers are now on RCECD-F-11 run cards. I’ve activated the manual dispatch protocol per RCECD-OPS-2026 Section 7. Dispatchers are tracking unit status on the whiteboard and using the printed map book. We are now operating under manual dispatch.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the manual dispatch protocol has been initiated. Watch for the supervisor to announce 'CAD down, go to cards' on all talkgroups and begin verifying manual tracking procedures.
